title: poa lagopoides
intro: Poa lagopoides, commonly known as Alpine Fescue or Snowy Grass, is a species of grass that belongs to the Poaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory conditions, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Poa lagopoides include its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which can help to soothe and calm irritated airways. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
